f.title: Report adverse drug reactions known to the company (mandatory notification)
f.statement: Notification of adverse reactions to medicines by the health professional or the manufacturer (industriel) who becomes aware of them is mandatory.
f.applicability: Adverse reactions to medicines in Cameroon

rows.actor: Pharmaceutical manufacturer / marketing authorisation holder (and health professionals)
rows.quote:
La notification des effets indésirables liés aux médicaments, par le professionnel de santé ou
l'industriel qui en a connaissance, est obligatoire.
rows.review_note: Review: 'est obligatoire' = Mandatory; re-translation agrees. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: The notification of adverse effects related to medicines, by the health professional or the manufacturer who becomes aware of them, is mandatory.

f.title: Report all suspected adverse events, including misuse, errors, lack of efficacy and defective products
f.statement: Notification covers any suspected adverse event relating to any health product occurring under normal conditions of use or relating to misuse, abuse, drug dependence, withdrawal syndrome, lack of efficacy, medication error or drug interaction, and any adverse effect relating to a defective (contaminated, adulterated, counterfeit, expired) product; it also covers adverse events in the conceptus following drug exposure during pregnancy, and covers expected or unexpected, serious or non-serious effects observed in clinical practice, clinical trials or pharmacoepidemiology studies.
f.clause: III.2 Modalities for notification of adverse events

rows.actor: All notifiers, including the pharmaceutical industry
rows.quote:
La notification intéresse toute présomption d'Evénement Indésirables relative à tout
produit de santé, survenu dans les conditions normales d'utilisation ou relatif à un
mésusage, usage abusif, pharmacodépendance, syndrome de sevrage, manque
d'efficacité, erreur médicamenteuse, interaction médicamenteuse. Ainsi que tout effet
indésirable relatif à un produit défectueux (contaminé, adultéré, contrefait, périmé.)
Elle intéresse par ailleurs tout événement indésirable survenant chez le produit de
conception suite à une exposition médicamenteuse durant la grossesse
La notification intéressera les effets indésirables qu'ils soient attendus ou inattendus,
graves ou non graves; observés dans la pratique clinique, lors des essais cliniques ou lors
des études de pharmaco-épidémiologie
rows.location: III.2 Modalities for notification of adverse events
rows.review_note: Review: scope definition that changes what must be reported; its binding force comes from the mandatory notification in III.1 (descriptive 'intéresse' wording), recorded as Mandatory. Re-translation agrees. Double-check: below 90 because the level rests on III.1 rather than modal wording here.
rows.quote_en: Notification concerns any presumption of an adverse event relating to any health product, occurring under normal conditions of use or relating to misuse, abuse, drug dependence, withdrawal syndrome, lack of efficacy, medication error, drug interaction; as well as any adverse effect relating to a defective product (contaminated, adulterated, counterfeit, expired). It further concerns any adverse event occurring in the conceptus following drug exposure during pregnancy. Notification will concern adverse effects whether expected or unexpected, serious or non-serious; observed in clinical practice, during clinical trials or during pharmacoepidemiology studies.

f.title: Include patient, event, suspect product and reporter details in each notification
f.statement: A notification contains the following elements of the case: the patient (identification and socio-economic characteristics); the adverse event (description, time to onset after drug intake, re-administration with or without recurrence, associated factors, corrective treatment, differential diagnoses with examination data, seriousness, outcome after withdrawal or dose reduction); the suspect medicine or health product (start and stop dates, dosage and route, indication, all concomitant products including those taken in the two weeks before onset); and the notifier (name, contact and signature).
f.clause: III.2 Modalities for notification - content of the notification
f.processes: Case processing & follow-up; Safety intake & collection

rows.actor: All notifiers, including the pharmaceutical industry
rows.quote: b- L'événement indésirable (El) lié aux médicaments et produits de Santé Description de l'El; Délai d'apparition après la prise médicamenteuse; Notion de ré administration avec ou sans rechute si elle a été effectuée; Facteurs associés favorisant l'apparition de l'El; Traitement correcteur instauré; Diagnostics différentiels avec les données des examens effectués en vue d'étayer le diagnostic; Gravité; Evolution de l'El après arrêt ou diminution de la dose. c- Le médicament ou produit de santé suspect Date de début et d'arrêt du traitement; Posologie et voie d'administration; Motif de la prescription (indication) ; Information sur tous les médicaments ou autres produits de santé concomitants et; même ceux pris dans les deux semaines qui précédent l'apparition de l'El. d- Le notificateur: nom, contact et signature.
rows.location: III.2 Modalities for notification - content of the notification
rows.review_note: Review: quote re-cut to the item list b-d (event, suspect product, notifier); item a (patient: identification and socio-economic characteristics) is in the preceding lead-in, which is OCR-damaged, and is cited in the statement. Indicative 'comporte' read as Mandatory (content a notification contains). Double-check: patient item rests on the damaged lead-in; below 90.
rows.quote_en: b- The adverse event (AE) related to medicines and health products: Description of the AE; Time to onset after drug intake; Notion of re-administration with or without recurrence if performed; Associated factors favouring the onset of the AE; Corrective treatment instituted; Differential diagnoses with the data from examinations performed to support the diagnosis; Seriousness; Course of the AE after withdrawal or dose reduction. c- The suspect medicine or health product: Start and stop dates of treatment; Dosage and route of administration; Reason for prescription (indication); Information on all concomitant medicines or other health products, even those taken in the two weeks preceding the onset of the AE. d- The notifier: name, contact and signature.

f.title: Use the yellow notification form (paper or electronic) to report
f.statement: Adverse events are notified on the yellow notification form, in paper or electronic format; transmission may use any means of communication (CNPV website, telephone, fax, post, on-site consultation).
f.clause: III.2 Modalities for notification - form and channels

électronique. La transmission des notifications peut se faire par tous les moyens de
communication:

f.title: MAH is responsible for the safety of its medicines and must have a PV unit under a qualified person
f.statement: Every holder of a marketing authorisation for a proprietary medicine is responsible for the safety of the medicine it markets. It must have a service for the collection, recording and evaluation of adverse effects under the responsibility of a person qualified in pharmacovigilance.
f.clause: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry
f.applicability: Holders of an AMM in Cameroon

rows.quote:
Tout détenteur d'une Autorisation de Mise sur le Marché (AMM) d'une spécialité est:
responsable de la sécurité du médicament qu'il commercialise. Il doit disposer d'un
service de recueil, d'enregistrement et d'évaluation des effets indésirables sous la
responsabilité d'une personne qualifiée en pharmacovigilance.
rows.location: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry
rows.review_note: Review: 'doit' = Mandatory; re-translation agrees. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: Every holder of a Marketing Authorisation (MA) for a proprietary medicinal product is responsible for the safety of the medicine it markets. It must have a service for the collection, recording and evaluation of adverse effects under the responsibility of a person qualified in pharmacovigilance.

f.title: Process, assess causality of and transmit cases collected by medical representatives
f.statement: Adverse reaction cases reported by medical representatives after collection from prescribers must be processed, assessed for causality (imputed) and transmitted to the CNPV.
f.clause: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry
f.applicability: Adverse reactions collected by medical representatives
f.processes: Safety intake & collection; Case processing & follow-up; Medical review

rows.quote:
Les cas d'effets indésirables rapportés par les délégués médicaux après collecte auprès
des prescripteurs, doivent être traités, imputés et transmis au CNPV.
rows.location: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry
rows.quote_en: Adverse effect cases reported by medical representatives after collection from prescribers must be processed, assessed for causality and transmitted to the CNPV.

f.title: Transmit safety information updates and foreign PV decisions to the DPML
f.statement: Updates of safety information on health products and pharmacovigilance decisions taken in other countries must be transmitted by manufacturers to the Directorate of Pharmacy, Medicines and Laboratories.
f.topic: Foreign regulatory actions and safety updates
f.clause: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry
f.processes: Submission operations; Regulatory intelligence; Safety labeling

rows.quote:
La mise à jour des informations sur la sécurité des produits de santé ainsi que les
décisions de pharmacovigilance prises dans les autres pays doivent être transmises par
les industriels à la Direction du Médicament de la Pharmacie et laboratoire ..
rows.location: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry
rows.review_note: Review: 'doivent' = Mandatory; no time limit stated. Double-check: OK.
rows.quote_en: Updates of information on the safety of health products, as well as pharmacovigilance decisions taken in other countries, must be transmitted by manufacturers to the Directorate of Medicines, Pharmacy and Laboratories.

f.title: Notify fatal or life-threatening serious ADRs to the CNPV within 7 calendar days
f.statement: For marketed medicines, serious adverse drug reactions involving death or a threat to life must be notified to the CNPV within 7 calendar days.
f.clause: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry - Marketed medicines
f.applicability: Marketed medicines; serious ADRs with death or threat to life

rows.deadline: 7 calendar days (fatal or life-threatening serious ADRs)
rows.location: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry - Marketed medicines

Below 90 because the clock start for the 7-day limit is inferred.

f.title: Notify other serious ADRs to the CNPV within 15 days of awareness

f.applicability: Marketed medicines; serious ADRs other than fatal or life-threatening

f.title: Transmit non-serious ADRs quarterly to the Directorate of Medicines and Pharmacy
f.statement: For marketed medicines, non-serious adverse reactions are to be transmitted quarterly to the Directorate of Medicines and Pharmacy.
f.clause: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry - Marketed medicines

rows.quote:
Les effets indésirables non graves seront transmis trimestriellement à la Direction du
Médicament et de la Pharmacie;
rows.location: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry - Marketed medicines
rows.review_note: Review: future indicative 'seront transmis' in a list of reporting rules read as Mandatory. No deadline_rule (recurring period, no submission day). Double-check: modal is indicative; below 90.
rows.quote_en: Non-serious adverse effects will be transmitted quarterly to the Directorate of Medicines and Pharmacy;

f.title: Companies may obtain a quarterly ADR report on their products from the CNPV
f.statement: Pharmaceutical companies may also obtain each quarter from the CNPV a report on adverse reactions to the medicines they market.
f.clause: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry - Marketed medicines
f.applicability: Medicines marketed by the company in Cameroon

rows.quote:
Les laboratoires pharmaceutiques peuvent également récupérer trimestriellement, auprès
du CNPV, un rapport sur les effets indésirables des médicaments qu'ils
commercialisent.
rows.location: IV. Role of the pharmaceutical industry - Marketed medicines
rows.quote_en: Pharmaceutical companies may also retrieve quarterly, from the CNPV, a report on the adverse effects of the medicines they market.
